correctness.rationale: Strict convexity on connected Laplacians and edge injectivity give a unique unrestricted optimizer. Budget-saturating symmetry reduction to matching/off-matching classes follows from uniqueness. The exact Laplacian eigenvalues 2d, nb (n−1 times), and 2a+(n−2)b (n−1 times) reconstruct the Kirchhoff-index objective. Differentiation and convexity along the one-dimensional budget line prove the sharp c_n support threshold, unique positive root, price regimes and expansion. Verified symbolic identities, rational matrix inverses, numerical random checks; finite verification is supplementary. Explicit boundary n≥3, c,B>0 and disconnection at b=0 are respected.

value.rationale: The exact all-price conductance allocation and sharp optional-link screening law resolve a natural economic network-design question: when an entire orbit of matched pair links ceases to be worth any investment. The threshold is a non-obvious rational function with asymptotic price premium 2/n; it applies to an infinite topology family and unrestricted non-invariant allocations. A known endpoint formula, generic KKT, and routine graph relabelings alone would not supply this phase diagram.
